executiveSummary: CONDITIONAL / NEEDS REVIEW: Legitimate B2B developer tool SaaS with verified company registration, active GitHub integration, and clean security disclosures. However, merchant lacks an explicit Refund & Cancellation Policy page. B2B annual subscription terms do not mention pro-rata cancellation rights or trial chargeback guidelines. Recommended action: Request merchant to publish an explicit Refund & Cancellation SLA before full payment activation.
